dedupe_keys.name: kepco substations able to supply each area 지역별 공급가능 변전소 정보 by province city and neighbourhood

description: This KEPCO data set lists, for each administrative area of South Korea, the substations that can supply it, so users can see which substations serve a province, city or county and neighbourhood (si-do, si-gun-gu and eup-myeon-dong). The Public Data Portal listing, last modified on 6 September 2025, offers it as CSV with JSON and XML through the open API and shows more than 21,000 views and 4,600 downloads, with keywords including de-identified and administrative district. The Industrial Data Service Portal entry, which was the candidate found, shows a data refresh on 26 September 2026, an irregular update cycle and free access. Coverage is South Korea. Files are free; no licence text was visible on the pages read. Caveats: it maps areas to substations, not giving substation coordinates, capacities or network connections, and the column set was not visible on the pages read. Simulation uses are linking local demand and exposed areas to the substations that feed them, for outage impact and hosting studies. Related records: data-epsis-korea-electric-power-statistics gives substation statistics by region.
